card.fires_on: Words just before a term for an incidental result, such as the end of unintentional before side effect, or the by in by-product. It fires on the parts of these phrases, not on the final noun.

modes.label: Inside unintentional
modes.description: The pieces of unintentional just before the words side effect.

modes.label: Inside by-product
modes.description: The by or product pieces of by-product, byproduct or a by-product phrase.
modes.example: Palm wine is produced as a<< by>>-product of palm vinegar.
